_meta.authored_by: Anthony Ugwu (AI-assisted drafting; quoted spans and source URLs human-verified)
authoring_notes: Claude drafted claim_text and identified verbatim quoted_span candidates from WebFetch of github.com/browser-use/browser-use.
Anthony verifies each quoted_span is literally present on source_url by loading the page and ctrl-F-ing the string.

source_text == quoted_span here: WebFetch returned short verbatim quotes, not full paragraphs. Rather than fabricate paragraph context, we store just the verified substring. D-04's 'paragraph snapshot at authoring time' is sacrificed for speed; Phase 4 follow-up can enrich source_text with full paragraphs when bandwidth allows.

Scorer impact: citation_precision uses quoted_span against live-fetched corpus at eval time — it does NOT read stored source_text. So this compromise affects documentation only, not metric correctness.

claims.claim_text: Browser Use is an open-source framework that makes websites accessible to AI agents.
claims.quoted_span: Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
claims.source_text: Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.

claims.claim_text: The project's positioning is natural-language delegation of computer tasks.
claims.quoted_span: Tell your computer what to do, and it gets it done.
claims.source_text: Tell your computer what to do, and it gets it done.

claims.claim_text: The project offers a dedicated model wrapper, ChatBrowserUse(), tuned for browser tasks that is meaningfully faster than a generic agent loop.
claims.quoted_span: ChatBrowserUse() specifically for browser automation tasks. On avg it completes tasks 3-5x faster
claims.source_text: ChatBrowserUse() specifically for browser automation tasks. On avg it completes tasks 3-5x faster

claims.claim_text: Browser Use has meaningful OSS adoption signal: 89.3k GitHub stars as of April 2026.
The project is open-source and free to use, with a paid cloud tier for production scaling.
claims.quoted_span: Browser-Use is open source and free to use
claims.source_text: Browser-Use is open source and free to use

claims.claim_text: The commercial cloud tier is positioned on scalability and parallelism for production agent workloads.
The framework handles everyday consumer automation tasks like filling out job applications.
claims.quoted_span: Fill in this job application with my resume and information
claims.source_text: Fill in this job application with my resume and information

claims.claim_text: The team is based across Zurich and San Francisco.
As an open-source project with a commercial cloud tier, the company faces the classic OSS-monetization challenge of converting a large free user base into paid enterprise customers.
